info.name: E7GZ PS — E7-22 (Sprint 1 contract + web session)
info.description: E7-22 only: Venue/Admin HttpOnly cookie session, CSRF (Origin + X-Requested-With), CORS, deny-all outside /api, customer app unchanged, and the new Sprint 1 contract endpoints. Backend must run with E7GZ_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:5174. Run tools/postman/seed-test-accounts.sql first.

item.name: A · Venue cookie session
item.description: Needs tools/postman/seed-test-accounts.sql. The cookie is sent by hand (cookie jar disabled) so each case is exact.

item.name: Venue login → 200, accessToken only, refresh token in a strict HttpOnly cookie (7 days)
Refresh without X-Requested-With → 403 FORBIDDEN (CSRF), nothing changes
Refresh with X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest → 403 (must be e7gz)
Refresh from another origin → 403 FORBIDDEN (CORS refuses it, error envelope)
Refresh from the Dashboard → 200, cookie rotated, CORS headers
